notes.title: Patch Notes v.2.1.950
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27442023/bfae3ae92bf3eb3c19e0d6827e965d61e421c84b.png

Some of you might have noticed that the last four months we have not made an update, which would be odd since we patch every month. 
We have had people contacting us and asking what have we been up to. Well, this is it: the mother of all of our patches! 
So what is new? Well, first of all since the release of Crash Force we have had people going on and on about Crash Force going free to play. 
We have been working on a way to make this possible the last 7 months and finally today is the day that we can say: 

 "CRASH FORCE IS FREE TO PLAY!"

For all players that already had the game, before going free to play, we did not forget about you. Your loyalty has been rewarded with $50 worth of items (2 legendary lootboxes and 1 rare lootbox). 


This is just the tip of the iceberg though. We decided to offer a lot more freedom to the way you interact with our matchmaking process. 
Players are now able to create their own matches and broadcast them to everybody else. 
That also means that you also get to pick on which match you want to enter as a player.
Furthermore, no one likes it when they have to always play on the same team, so now players can switch teams between matches. 
We did not stop there though, players now have the freedom to create games and restrict them to their LAN, allowing only their frienemies on their LAN to enter the game created.
Since Day-0 of our release you have been requesting an offline mode, and IT IS HERE! Players can now enter a match with only bots to harness their skills before entering combat with other players.
Speaking of new additions, we have created a new game mode named Control The Nest. Yeap, you guessed it. It is a points contest match where the team controlling the fewer points loses points until their points reach 0. 
How many points are lost per second are calculated based on the difference of points controlled (i.e. the more points you control, the faster the other team will lose).
The last 7 months we noticed that a very common phenomenon was players entering different game modes at different times making it impossible to have a full throttle match. 
We decided that in order to get the players together, it would be better to have all game modes and maps randomly rotating. 
That way everyone who wants to play with other players will be together and passing through different game modes and maps without having the need to go back and change their preferences. 

Since we were making changes, we decided to also make "some" Main Menu changes to better reflect the state of the game now and highlight some features that were not easily accessible (i.e. lootboxes).
"Some" changes quickly turned into a COMPLETE MAIN MENU OVERHAUL with everything being more simple, better organised and more vibrant!

We also heard your feedback about the skill tree system being too complex, confusing and somewhat repetitive and we have changed it completely as well. 
We added new skills and organised the old ones better to provide a more versatile and more neat gameplay.
 
For existing players, the skillpoints that were assigned in your trees have been reset for free allowing you to choose new paths. 

 
 See you in the arena.

 "CRASH IS IMMINENT!"

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.5.3443
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27442023/e2536037771da86c46aacd4e4425b64ba91fee62.jpg

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where sometimes entering the tutorial would crash the game.
Fixed an issue where the match end card would show points earned from previous matches.


Changes:

Changed music in all maps.
Cicuma Nebulosa is now available.
Clava Jubatus is now available.
The redesigned Clava Tombs is now available.
Game is now even more fast-paced with smaller ability cooldowns, smaller ability durations, no second step activations, more base damage, more base speed and more base health regeneration.
Bots will now take the level of the lowest player in game (+/-3). Bots will use abilities only if their level is bigger than 1 and a percentage of boost will be given to them, affecting weapon damage, weapon Rate of Fire, Health and Speed, based on their level (max level 90 = 4.5%).
New hovering animation in Craft Gallery.


Graphics changes:

Clava Tombs revisit.

Optimizations:

Reduced the resolution of certain lightmaps to optimize the performance of the texture streamer.
Network optimizations.

Lobby Screen now shows the selected hovercraft name inside the Player Information Row.
Added UI SFX to enhance the general feedback upon pressing and hovering buttons inside the Main Menu Screens (Still A work in Progress).

notes.title: Patch v.1.3.2289
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27442023/2378517de03e0a0bd1e2649125bc3961f6d2348d.jpg

Changes.

Server will now rotate through the 3 available maps.
    Entering a queue now will open a lobby and the countdown will start the game with as many bots needed to have a 3v3 match(based on actual players in lobby).
    If you enter the queue and a game that is in progress without the minimum number of players(6) is found, it will connect you as a spectator to be added in the lobby as soon as the game ends.
    Upon match end you will automatically be included in the lobby for the next match (no traveling back to menu).
    Selection of hovercrafts and skilltrees will happen in the lobby.
Skins and decals can be equipped from the menu (Hovercraft Gallery) for each hovercraft and will automatically be applied when selecting a hovercraft in the lobby.
Skins and Decals can now be purchased under the "Skins and Decals" section for each hovercraft.
The store section will now be consisted of only consumables such as "Reset Tokens" & "Exp Boosts" as well as the 4th-5th Skill Tree Slots.


Bug Fixes.

Fixed an issue where the skilltrees would not apply correctly.
Fixed K/D Value in the Overview Section of the profile tab.
Fixed an issue where Aquila Claim(Aquila Audax 3rd ability) would leave targets rooted indefinetely.


Added Features.

Major menu UI re-design.
In-game HUD reskinned.
360° view of hovercrafts in menu under "Preview Hovercraft".
Skin previewer in menu.
Added a verification box when trying to purchase items.


Full Patch Notes:
http://www.ascanioentertainment.com/index.php?option=com_k2&view=item&id=354:early-access-patch-v-1-3-2289&Itemid=916&lang=en

notes.title: Patch v.1.2.2124
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27442023/3ef7e3d026d978edd2318b2e0f7bc24fe3b13639.jpg

New in-Game HUD

    The UI has been changed in order to be easier to see your abilities and cooldowns (located at the bottom center part).
    The minimap has been relocated for easier visibility. (located at the bottom right).

In general, bigger fonts and better accessibility.

Main Menu UI.

Changed the cursor to its default configuration, since cursors designed with umg seem to be having some sort of acceleration, hence hard to handle on machines that produce
low frame-rates.


Ammo Packs. 

Ammo packs now display a timer when picked up, indicating how long until the next pack is available.


Voice Fx.

We have implemented voice effects for better feedback when performing certain actions in the game. 

We will continue developing the feedbacks systems in general so stay tuned for more.

Clava Diphylla is now available.
Being the second hovercraft of the Clavae family.

Weapons

Weapon 1: Rifle
Weapon 2: Bladerunner


Abilities

Ability 1: Diphylla can target an enemy and curse him for x ammount of time impairing his movement and damaging the enemy.
Ability 2: Diphylla sacrifices health to increase it's power. Less health, more power.
Ability 3: Diphylla sacrifices energy to regenerate health.
Ability 4: Diphylla scans the environment making it able to see enemies behind objects and sturctures.


Bug Fixes

Fixed empty messages bug.

notes.title: Early Access - Lobby/Match-making arrangement Update
notes.notes:
After monitoring the game creation, queue times and all the games on the servers, we have decided to push a temporary update in order to shorten the queue times and make matches a more engaging and interactive experience. To do so we will temporarily limit the possible combinations of map/mode selection. That way, we will meet in bigger lobbies and have a better experience with much lower queue times.

We also want to let you know that we are taking your ideas and suggestions in the Discussions under serious consideration and we encourage you to keep doing so.
Update: 


Removed Cicuma Forest as an option in Map Selection
Removed Clava Tombs as an option in Map Selection
Removed Team Showdown as an option in Map Selection


We want to remind you that this is just a temporary measure until more people hit the servers.

The Ascanio Entertainment Team
